map_info.name: VFM_07_Gravity
map_info.description: Let five PointBody spheres attract one another with paired forces, softened at close range. Initial tangential velocity and disabled contact keep this an orbital model; entering adds the visitor as a sixth model mass. Compare a selective, three-second magnet and a hand-held gravity point with ordinary gravity: remove a bottom brick, cross a release threshold, and watch existing support cease to hold. Reconstruct the pairwise relation; the other experiments expose different boundary conditions.
map_info.title: The source can move too
